definitions.gloss: proposer; advocate; originator of an idea
definitions.explanation: The person who first put forward a theory, method, or movement and argues for it publicly. Used mainly of academic, technical, and social ideas rather than of everyday suggestions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{提唱者|ていしょうしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is the originator of this theory.

examples.japanese: {提唱者|ていしょうしゃ}⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The originator himself came to give the lecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{提唱者|ていしょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{無名|むめい}→無名：13420_mumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧だった。
examples.english: The person who first advocated that movement was, at the time, still an unknown researcher.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{提唱|ていしょう}→提唱：15590_teishou⟧ (advocacy, proposing) plus 〜⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person who). Usually appears after ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ naming what was proposed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{提唱者|ていしょうしゃ}: the originator of a theory
- {提唱者|ていしょうしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to be known as the person who proposed it
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{提唱者|ていしょうしゃ}: the first to advocate it
- {提唱者|ていしょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧: one of the proponents

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{創始者|そうししゃ}→創始者：27181_soushisha⟧: founder — stresses starting an organization or school, not arguing for an idea
- ⟦{推進者|すいしんしゃ}→推進者：30334_suishinsha⟧: promoter — pushes an idea forward without necessarily having originated it
